<subject>Base Petroleum, Inc - Sale Notification</subject>
<body>
There is a daily sale of 280 units that has been withdrawn from the CES 39999 pool on Southern Public's K#s for January. If I recall correctly, this has occurred over the last few months. This transaction was never entered into Halcyon Mutual Bank's system, so I have created ticket number 849271 (Halcyon's transaction ticket #).

Our transaction confirmation team states this deal does not appear in their records, and there is a CES representative on this team.

Please provide us with the GMS transaction number, and if available, the RiskWorks transaction number. If you have a copy of the transaction ticket, kindly fax it to me at 0207 555 4821.

Thank you.
</body>
